# Amazon.in

> India's leading e-commerce marketplace offering online shopping for mobiles, books, watches, shoes, groceries, and more with Prime membership, deals, and payment solutions.

Amazon.in is the Indian subsidiary of Amazon, providing a comprehensive online shopping platform with localized services including Amazon Fresh for groceries, Amazon Pay for digital payments, and Prime membership benefits tailored for Indian customers. The platform supports multiple regional languages and offers seller registration through Fulfilment by Amazon.

## Shopping & Browsing

- [Amazon.in Homepage](https://www.amazon.in): India's leading online marketplace for mobiles, books, watches, shoes and more
- [All Categories](https://www.amazon.in/b/32702023031): Complete product categories storefront with seller registration and fulfillment options
- [Bestsellers](https://www.amazon.in/gp/bestsellers): Most popular products across all categories on Amazon.in
- [Hot New Releases](https://www.amazon.in/gp/new-releases): New arrivals and trending products across all categories
- [Deals & Promotions](https://www.amazon.in/deals): Special offers and discounts across product categories

## Membership & Services

- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.in/prime): Prime membership plans starting ₹399/year with video, music and shopping benefits
- [Amazon Fresh](https://www.amazon.in/fresh): Online grocery shopping service with discounts up to 40%
- [Amazon Pay](https://www.amazon.in/gp/sva/dashboard): Digital payment dashboard for bill payments, recharges, travel and gift cards

## Account & Authentication

- [Sign In](https://www.amazon.in/gp/css/order-history): User authentication and account login portal for Amazon.in

## Support & Help

- [Customer Service & Help Center](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html): FAQs and support on shipping, returns, payments and account management

## Optional

- [Language & Regional Preferences](https://www.amazon.in/customer-preferences/edit): Customer language and regional preferences settings for Amazon India
